releaseNotes: Added a personal build flavor with a configurable app name and original equalizer launcher/notification branding.
Added a tap-to-skip 3.2-second startup intro and persisted Now Playing speed presets.
Made Stats for Nerds distinguish source-reported claims from current Media3 renderer information; unknown values remain explicit.
Hardened native JSON addon transport and update downloads with HTTPS/host checks, SHA-256 validation, signing-identity checks, byte progress and resumable partial downloads.
Added missing Simplified and Traditional Chinese strings.
migrationNotes: No application-ID or database schema migration was made. The checked-out app ID remains com.music.bitchord. An in-place update requires a signing certificate compatible with the installed build; this local APK uses the Android debug certificate. No public release/download URL is available yet.
